senses: 1) a Judean, son of the Maachathite, a captain of the Judean forces who visited Gedaliah at Mizpah after Gedaliah had been appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar
2) son of Shaphan, an elder of Israel in the days of Ezekiel
3) son of Azur, one of the princes of the people against whom Ezekiel was directed to prophesy
4) a Rechabite, son of Jeremiah the prophet
H2970.deriv: or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ; from {H238} and {H3050}; heard of Jah;

H2971.def: Jair, the name of four Israelites
senses: 1) a descendant of Manasseh who conquered many towns during the time of the conquest
2) the Gileadite, a judge of Israel for 22 years during the time of the judges; father of 30 sons
3) a Benjamite, son of Kish, and father of Mordecai
4) father of Elhanan, one of David's mighty warriors

H2972.def: a Jairite or descendant of Jair
senses: 1a) Ira the Jairite was a priest to David

H2973.def: properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish
senses: 1) to be foolish, become fools, act foolishly, show wicked folly

H2974.def: properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition
senses: 1) to begin, make a beginning, show willingness, undertake to do, be pleased, be determined
1a1) to agree to, show willingness, acquiesce, accept an invitation, be willing
1a3) to resolve, be pleased, be determined
H2974.deriv: a primitive root (probably rather the same as {H2973} through the idea of mental weakness);
H2974.kjv: assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, [idiom] willingly, would.

H2975.def: a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria

H2976.kjv: (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

H2977.def: Joshijah, the name of two Israelites
senses: 1) son of Amon by Jedidah who succeeded his father to the throne of Judah and reigned for 31 years; his reign is noteworthy for the great revivals back to the worship of Jehovah which he led
2) a returned exile and son of Zephaniah at whose house took place the solemn and symbolical crowning of Joshua the high priest in the time of Zechariah the prophet
H2977.deriv: or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ; from the same root as {H803} and {H3050}; founded of Jah;

senses: 1) a Gershonite Levite, son of Zerah

H2981.def: produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth

H2982.def: Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem
senses: 1) an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'

H2983.def: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus
senses: 1) descendants of the 3rd son of Canaan who lived in or around the site of Jebus, the early name for Jerusalem
1) one of the sons of David, born in Jerusalem

H2985.def: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings
senses: 1) a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom
2) another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak

H2986.def: properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp)
senses: 1) to bring, lead, carry, conduct, bear along
1b3) to be brought, be led, be conducted
1) the son of Lamech by Adah and brother of Jubal; described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle
1) a city of Manasseh apparently located in the territory of either Issachar or Asher
1) (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
1a) the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name
H2992.deriv: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from {H2993};
H2992.kjv: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.

H2995.def: Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine
senses: 1) a town in Judah on the northern boundary near the sea
2) a town in Naphtali on the boundary in upper Galilee

H2999.def: Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan
senses: 1) a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea
